briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates with new model releases from major labs while regulatory and security concerns mount. US export controls on advanced chips continue to shape global compute access.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning gains; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind and xAI pushed new agents. DeepSeek-V3 closed the gap on open-source performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updated AI risk frameworks amid rising adversarial attacks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches volume production; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k+ H100 clusters. TSMC Arizona fab yields improved for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure before 2028?
